scenarios.name: hub-cascade
scenarios.title: Hub cascade: DFW ground stop
scenarios.blurb: DFW ground stop; AUS, IAH and MSP get knock-on notes.
scenarios.description: A two-hour ground stop at DFW (thunderstorms). Airports with heavy DFW service get a hub cascade note for the 1–4 hours after it: Austin (low clouds, Low) goes up one step to Moderate; Houston and Minneapolis (quiet) go to Low. Nothing becomes "Delays happening now" there, and Seattle (no DFW in its top routes) gets nothing. A calendar trip MSP→DFW leaving after the ground stop ends shows the specific knock-on concern.

assert.re: ^DFW ground stop may delay flights to and from Dallas–Fort Worth$
^DFW ground stop may delay flights to and from Dallas–Fort Worth$
^DFW ground stop may delay some flights to and from Dallas–Fort Worth$
^Your MSP→DFW leg: DFW ground stop — knock-on delays possible around your .+ departure\.$
DFW ground stop may delay flights to and from Dallas–Fort Worth
DFW ground stop may delay some flights to and from Dallas–Fort Worth

assert.text: Test scenario: Hub cascade: DFW ground stop

^MIA is closed until .+ — your .+ arrival is likely cancelled or diverted\.$
